ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater (TA450 / Mango Sandstorm) legitimate-RMM agent deployment as primary implant
ucs.description: Hunts execution/installation of legitimate remote-management agents (Atera, ScreenConnect/ConnectWise, RemoteUtilities, SimpleHelp, Syncro, N-able) that MuddyWater repeatedly weaponizes as its main foothold after spear-phishing — they prefer signed RMM tooling over custom malware to blend in and survive EDR. Ties first-seen RMM execution per host to that tradecraft.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("AteraAgent.exe","AteraAgentSetup.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","ConnectWiseControl.ClientService.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","RemoteUtilities.exe","SimpleService.exe","Remote Workforce Client.exe","Syncro.Service.exe","SyncroSetup.exe","BASupSrvc.exe","BASupSrvcCnfg.exe","AweSun.exe") OR Processes.process="*atera*" OR Processes.process="*screenconnect*" OR Processes.process="*connectwisecontrol*" OR Processes.process="*remoteutilities*" OR Processes.process="*simplehelp*" OR Processes.process="*syncro*" OR Processes.process="*n-able*" OR Processes.process="*take control*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where user!="*$"
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let RmmBinaries = dynamic(["AteraAgent.exe","AteraAgentSetup.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","ConnectWiseControl.ClientService.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","RemoteUtilities.exe","SimpleService.exe","Syncro.Service.exe","SyncroSetup.exe","BASupSrvc.exe","BASupSrvcCnfg.exe","AweSun.exe"]);
let BaselineDays = 30d;
let Baseline = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp between (ago(BaselineDays) .. ago(1d))
    | where FileName in~ (RmmBinaries)
    | summarize by DeviceName, FileName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where FileName in~ (RmmBinaries)
   or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("atera","screenconnect","connectwisecontrol","remoteutilities","simplehelp","syncro","take control")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=leftanti Baseline on DeviceName, FileName    // first-seen RMM on this host
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          FileName, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let RmmBinaries = dynamic(["ateraagent.exe","ateraagentsetup.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.clientservice.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","remoteutilities.exe","simpleservice.exe","syncro.service.exe","syncrosetup.exe","basupsrvc.exe","basupsrvccnfg.exe","awesun.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ProcImage = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ProcImage in (RmmBinaries)
   or CommandLine has_any ("atera","screenconnect","connectwisecontrol","remoteutilities","simplehelp","syncro")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: MuddyWater Legitimate RMM Agent Execution
id: 8f1c2a4e-9d3b-4c7a-bd11-7e2f5a6c9d01
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of legitimate remote-management agents abused by MuddyWater (TA450) as primary implant
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\AteraAgent.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe'
      - '\ConnectWiseControl.ClientService.exe'
      - '\rutserv.exe'
      - '\rfusclient.exe'
      - '\Syncro.Service.exe'
      - '\BASupSrvc.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'atera'
      - 'screenconnect'
      - 'remoteutilities'
      - 'simplehelp'
  condition: selection_img or selection_cmd
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned IT helpdesk use of the same RMM suite
level: medium
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\AteraAgent.exe OR *\ateraagent.exe OR *\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\screenconnect.clientservice.exe OR *\rutserv.exe OR *\RUTSERV.exe OR *\rfusclient.exe OR *\Syncro.Service.exe OR *\BASupSrvc.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*atera* OR *Atera* OR *screenconnect* OR *ScreenConnect* OR *remoteutilities* OR *RemoteUtilities* OR *simplehelp* OR *SimpleHelp*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/(AteraAgent|AteraAgentSetup|ScreenConnect\.ClientService|ScreenConnect\.WindowsClient|ConnectWiseControl\.ClientService|rutserv|rfusclient|RemoteUtilities|SimpleService|Syncro\.Service|SyncroSetup|BASupSrvc|AweSun)\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/(atera|screenconnect|connectwisecontrol|remoteutilities|simplehelp|syncro)/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: MuddyWater/TA450/Mango Sandstorm is the standout state actor that operationalizes commodity signed RMM agents (Atera, ScreenConnect, RemoteUtilities, SimpleHelp, Syncro) as its actual implant rather than custom malware — confirmed across Microsoft, Mandiant and CERT reporting. _sigma_issues: no MITRE ATT&CK tag (expected at least one `attack.t####`)

ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater (Seedworm / Static Kitten) Office→obfuscated-PowerShell backdoor chain
ucs.description: Hunts maldoc/macro execution where an Office or script-host parent spawns PowerShell with encoded/obfuscated download-and-execute arguments — the POWERSTATS/PowGoop loader pattern MuddyWater has reused for years. Decodes the base64 inline to expose the staged C2 payload.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe")) AND (Processes.process="*-enc*" OR Processes.process="*-EncodedCommand*" OR Processes.process="*FromBase64String*" OR Processes.process="*DownloadString*" OR Processes.process="*DownloadFile*" OR Processes.process="*IEX*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-Expression*" OR Processes.process="*-w hidden*" OR Processes.process="*-WindowStyle hidden*" OR Processes.process="*-nop*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where user!="*$"
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc","-EncodedCommand","FromBase64String","DownloadString","DownloadFile","IEX","Invoke-Expression","-w hidden","-WindowStyle Hidden","-nop","-NonInteractive","bitstransfer")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend B64 = extract(@"(?i)(?:-(?:e(?:nc(?:odedcommand)?)?))\s+([A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,})", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend Decoded = base64_decode_tostring(B64)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          FileName, ProcessCommandLine, B64, Decoded, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentImg = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ProcImg = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentImg in ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
| where ProcImg in ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any ("-enc","-EncodedCommand","FromBase64String","DownloadString","DownloadFile","IEX","Invoke-Expression","-w hidden","-WindowStyle Hidden","-nop")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend B64 = extract(@"(?i)(?:-(?:e(?:nc(?:odedcommand)?)?))\s+([A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,})", 1, CommandLine)
| extend Decoded = base64_decode_tostring(B64)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, B64, Decoded
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: MuddyWater Office-Spawned Obfuscated PowerShell Loader
id: 2c7d9b13-4a6e-4f82-9c01-3b8e1d2f6a04
status: experimental
description: Office/script-host parent spawning PowerShell with encoded or download-execute arguments, matching MuddyWater POWERSTATS/PowGoop chains
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
  child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
  args:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-enc'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'DownloadFile'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - '-w hidden'
      - '-nop'
  condition: parent and child and args
falsepositives:
  - Rare admin macros invoking signed PS scripts
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\winword.exe OR *\WINWORD.EXE OR *\excel.exe OR *\EXCEL.EXE OR *\powerpnt.exe OR *\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CScript.exe) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\cmd.exe) @CommandLine:(*-enc* OR *-EncodedCommand* OR *FromBase64String* OR *DownloadString* OR *DownloadFile* OR *IEX* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *"-w hidden"* OR *-nop*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook|mshta|wscript|cscript)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh|cmd)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(-enc|-EncodedCommand|FromBase64String|DownloadString|DownloadFile|IEX|Invoke-Expression|-w hidden|-WindowStyle hidden|-nop)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: MuddyWater's signature initial-access-to-execution chain is a macro/maldoc spawning obfuscated PowerShell loaders (POWERSTATS, PowGoop, PowerMud) that stage C2 over HTTP — documented since 2017 across Seedworm/Static Kitten reporting. Pairing the Office/script-host parent with encoded download-execute child args (and decoding the base64 inline) isolates that exact tradecraft rather than generic Po
_sigma_issues: no MITRE ATT&CK tag (expected at least one `attack.t####`)
